errors.evidence: The description does not mention the legend entry "heaps" for the green line.

The description of the initial trend is incorrect. The line starts near a Z Score of 0.1, rises to a small local peak of approximately 0.5, and then begins to decrease. It does not start its descent from a Z-score of 0.4.
The peak of the curve is visibly above the 1.5 tick mark on the y-axis, reaching a value of approximately 1.6. Stating it increases to 'about 1.5' is an inaccurate understatement.
The final value of the line at the right end of the x-axis is approximately -1.5, not -1.4. The line ends at the level of the -1.5 tick mark.
